major_findings.title: Baseline scheduler passes robust validation library while its resource estimate counts clean only
major_findings.reproduction: Real one-epoch SYNTHETIC_ONLY B-CAT fit, two dense synthetic valid rows: without supplied library predict() calls=2; with shared library calls=290, and attempted96 appears despite clean checkpoint objective. Counts include epoch validation plus restored-best evaluation.
major_findings.impact: All24 baseline fits inherit144 unnecessary damaged views per evaluation. Proposed estimate uses1 view, so it does not describe the scheduler's actual work and can exhaust a deadline-bound campaign.
major_findings.bounded_fix: Pass no library for B objectives or normalize library=None inside fit when objective=clean. Preserve attempted96 for C0/R0/R1/R2/R1-CAP. Recalculate proposed resource caps on corrected path and preserve source-bound measurement evidence. Existing attempt1 profile lacks source_sha256/command/exit_code and should not be presented as exact-current-source proof.

major_findings.title: A single exact-version owner approval can launch repeated39-fit campaigns
major_findings.reproduction: Two execute_core invocations with identical config and the same mocked authority, different fresh private output directories, mocked source loader and mocked fit: both completed scheduling, total78 fit calls. No official data, native journals or optimizer steps were involved.
major_findings.impact: The native binding covers commit/config/freeze and core_budget39, but no one-use campaign identity/state. retry_training_budget=0 and finite trial states reset per new directory. Reinvocation after a failed or completed campaign can consume unapproved additional fits.
major_findings.bounded_fix: Bind approval to a unique campaign ID/private output identity and persistent fixed-host one-use claim. Repeated invocation cannot initialize another campaign. Any resume remains within the registered campaign and registered checkpoints, or requires separate explicit resume authority; do not silently restart completed fits.

major_findings.title: Result-persistence failure leaves false COMPLETED event and masks the original failure
major_findings.reproduction: Mocked synthetic scheduler, inject OSError only when evaluation.json is written. Recorded states remain RUNNING,COMPLETED; evaluation.json does not exist; returned error becomes ValueError('Invalid transition or unauthorized retry') instead of the injected persistence failure.
major_findings.impact: The campaign stops with an incorrect durable completion record and loses the actionable failure in its event log.
major_findings.bounded_fix: Persist required evaluation evidence successfully before COMPLETED; on write failure record FAILED while state remains RUNNING and re-raise original exception. Add the focused injected-I/O regression.

minor_findings.title: Approved resource envelope is not tied to execution device
minor_findings.detail: Resource profile used CUDA, while CLI defaults to CPU and device is outside the native binding. A default official invocation can therefore use a materially different runtime basis.
minor_findings.recommendation: For the concrete owner-facing execution command, bind or validate the measured device/runtime in execution config; avoid relying on an easy-to-omit CLI option.
